OG-20.from: Solar works brilliantly in summer and on clear days. But winter, storms, and extended cloudy periods reduce output by 50–70%.
OG-20.to: Solar generates most in summer and on clear days, and less in winter, storms and long cloudy spells.
OG-20.reason: '50–70%' is unsourced. energy.gov.au: a solar system 'will generate less electricity in winter than in summer'.

OG-20.to: □ A safe outdoor spot to run a generator (well ventilated, exhaust pointing away from the house)
OG-20.reason: SITING: a 'generator shed' reads as running it in an enclosed space, which both markets prohibit (WorkSafe: well-ventilated place, never indoors; ESV: never in enclosed areas).

OG-20.from: YES → Measure the head (vertical drop) and flow rate. If head > 10m: micro-hydro is likely your best option. Consistent, reliable, low maintenance.
OG-20.to: YES → Micro-hydro may suit your property. Ask a specialist to assess the head (vertical drop) and flow, and check what rules and permissions apply to using the stream.
OG-20.reason: Removes the '> 10m' threshold, 'likely your best option' and 'Consistent, reliable, low maintenance' (unsourced).

OG-20.from: Q2: Is your property exposed with average winter winds > 4 m/s?
OG-20.to: Q2: Is your property exposed to strong, steady winter winds?

OG-20.from: YES → Small wind turbine viable. Best paired with solar (solar summer + wind winter = balanced year). Check council noise rules.
OG-20.to: YES → A small wind turbine may be viable — have the site's wind assessed first. Where winter winds are strong, wind can complement solar. Check your council's rules, including on noise.
OG-20.reason: 'viable' and 'balanced year' overstate; a site assessment decides.

OG-20.from: YES → Standby generator with auto-transfer switch. Most reliable for whole-house backup. Higher running costs but seamless.
OG-20.to: YES → A standby generator with an automatic changeover (transfer) switch can start supplying power when the grid fails. Its connection must be installed by a licensed electrical worker. Running costs are higher (fuel).
OG-20.reason: CONNECTION: adds that the changeover connection is licensed electrical work (WorkSafe bulletin). Removes 'Most reliable for whole-house backup' and 'seamless' (unsourced).

OG-20.from: NO / Budget limited → Portable generator for essential loads only. Store safely. Test monthly. Keep fuel fresh.
OG-20.to: NO / Budget limited → A portable generator can run a few essential appliances. Use it and store its fuel safely (see Using a generator safely), and test it regularly as the manufacturer's instructions describe.
OG-20.reason: OPERATING/FUEL: 'Test monthly' and 'Keep fuel fresh' are unsourced; replaced with the manufacturer's instructions and the generator block.
'Consents' is NZ terminology; AU requirements vary by state and territory (as OG-27 AU).
